summary: Public projects created on 29 October 2026: 2 repos, 1 dataset and 3 models.
intro: New repositories covered voice-data preparation and rclone administration, with a tool that trims clicks from training recordings and agent skills for remotes, mounts and config backup. On Hugging Face, the work was wake-word and dictation cleanup: two "Hey Yossi" models, a fine-tune that edits raw dictation, and a reference dataset.

projects.name: Keyclick Detector
projects.description: Detects keyboard and mouse clicks at the start and end of voice-training recordings so they can be trimmed. Trained on real recorder takes.

projects.name: Rclone Manager
projects.description: Agent skills for routine rclone admin: install, remotes, mounts, config backup and migration, docs lookup

projects.name: Hey Yossi microWakeWord
projects.description: A custom "Hey Yossi" wake word for microWakeWord, trained 2026-10-29. It is a streaming, int8-quantised TFLite model of 61 KB.

projects.name: Hey Yossi openWakeWord
projects.description: A custom "Hey Yossi" wake word for openWakeWord, trained 2026-10-29 for a personal voice assistant.

projects.name: S1 ASR Cleanup
projects.description: S1-ASR-Cleanup is a fine-tune of S1-mini by Superwhisper (superwhisper/s1-mini, Qwen3-0.6B) that cleans raw speech-to-text dictation the way one user edits his own.
